summary: The Israeli military confirmed its troops have begun a ground assault on the Gaza Strip that includes tanks and additional air assaults, after massing over 10,000 troops and equipment along the Israel-Gaza border in what was believed to be preparation for a ground invasion, the Israeli government said. A spokesman for the Israeli Ministry of Foreign Affairs said IDF forces have begun the second stage of Operation Cast Lead to "destroy the terrorist infrastructure of the Hamas" and take control of rocket-launching areas to greatly reduce rockets fired at Israel; the military began a massive air assault on Hamas forces and government officials several days before troops entered the Strip, and reports say Israeli forces are engaging in gun battles with Hamas as they enter the city, which Hamas had warned would be fought violently. The IDF said civilians are not its target, dropped leaflets warning residents to leave the area, and stated that "Those who use civilians, the elderly, women and children as 'human shields' are responsible for any and all injury" and that "Anyone who hides a terrorist or weapons in his house is considered a terrorist."
